items.title: Matthew Stafford: Modest numbers in Week 12 win
items.description:
Stafford completed 16 of 23 passes for 141 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed once for no gain in the Rams' 26-13 win over the Packers on Wednesday night. He also committed a fumble recovered by Los Angeles.

items.title: Jordan Love: Struggles against Rams in loss
items.description:
Love completed 17 of 29 passes for 198 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed once for seven yards in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams on Wednesday night.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Completely overshadowed by Corum
items.description:
